```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
options(ta.no_main = TRUE)   # load the functions without auto-running them
```

## 1. Load functions

`stock_functions.R` holds the import and statistics functions;
`display_stocks.R` holds the display and visualization functions.

```{r functions}
source("display_stocks.R")   # also sources stock_functions.R
```

## 2. Portfolio

```{r portfolio}
read_portfolio("portfolio.txt")
```

## 3. Import stock data

```{r import}
stocks <- load_stock_data("portfolio.txt")
names(stocks)
```

## 4. Imported data frames

```{r display}
display_stock_data(stocks)
```

### Quote summary

```{r quote}
knitr::kable(display_quote_summary(stocks))
```

## 5. Calculated statistics

```{r stats}
stats <- calculate_all_statistics(stocks)
display_statistics(stats)
```

### Comparison

```{r compare}
knitr::kable(statistics_comparison(stats), digits = 2)
```

## 6. Visualizations

```{r plots, results='asis'}
for (sym in names(stocks)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", sym, "\n\n")
  print(plot_price_ma(stats, sym))
  print(plot_close_hist(stocks, stats, sym))
}
```

### Portfolio comparison

```{r normalised}
plot_normalised(stocks)
plot_sd_comparison(stats)
```

### Candlestick chart (first stock, last 90 days)

```{r candles}
plot_candles(stocks, names(stocks)[1], days = 90)
```
